soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. Not checkable faithfully in Z3 because the main claim is a definition/postulate involving universal quantification over all of R^4, topological/analytic regularity such as C² except on a singularity set and L¹ integrability, plus informal notions of scalar/frame-independence and singularity. A finite SMT encoding would only check a trivial finite sample or satisfiability of χ ≥ 0, not the actual main claim.
